subject: Request: Temporary SLA exception & on-call delegation for weekend maintenance
messages:
From: Alex Barnes <alex@fintrade.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene@redwood.com>
Cc: ops@fintrade.com
Date: 2026-11-30T08:15:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Request: temporary SLA waiver for weekend maintenance

Hi Irene,

Quick context: FinTrade is planning a data-plane upgrade over the coming weekend (Sat Nov 28 - Sun Nov 29 local). Our SRE rotation has reduced headcount that weekend (several folks on PTO) which means our side will have slower initial responders for non-P1 issues.

We rely on Redwood P2 response windows for triage and triage routing. Can Redwood provide a temporary SLA exception (P2 -> 8 hour response window overnight APAC) plus a documented delegation playbook so our ops team can escalate directly to the Redwood on-call PA if we detect production regressions? We want to avoid a break-glass emergency but need formal confirmation and a point-of-contact.

Attachments: fintrade_exception_form.pdf

Thanks,
Alex Barnes
Head of Platform Ops, FinTrade
From: Irene Choi <irene@redwood.com>
To: Alex Barnes <alex@fintrade.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-30T09:02:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Request: temporary SLA waiver for weekend maintenance

Alex — thanks for the heads up and the form. Important ask; happy to help coordinate. A couple quick clarifying Qs so we can scope the exception and get approvals: 

- Exact maintenance window (start/end with time zone) and whether FinTrade needs the exception to start before their maintenance begins (i.e., pre-mitigation monitoring).
- Which metrics would you like Redwood to prioritize for fast follow (error-rate, 95th latency, failed requests/sec)?
- Do you want Redwood to accept direct escalation from any email in ops@fintrade.com, or a named roster of individuals?

We're going to propose a short-lived SLA carveout covering the stated maintenance window + 24 hours as a buffer. Ben (CS lead) — can you confirm if we can commit to P1 unchanged and P2 extended to 8 hours overnight for APAC for that window, and whether our on-call delegation flow below is acceptable?

Proposed delegation flow we plan to document:
1) FinTrade ops opens a ticket SUP-2134 (Jira) with severity and tags "maintenance-exception"
2) If P1 symptoms appear (latency spike >300% or error-rate >5% sustained 5m), FinTrade calls Redwood PA line and includes the SUP-2134 link
3) For P2 non-urgent degradations, FinTrade will file ticket and Redwood will respond within 8 hours overnight for the exception period

If that aligns, we'll draft a short playbook and routing tree and send it for signature (DocuSign).

—Irene
From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene@redwood.com>, Alex Barnes <alex@fintrade.com>
Cc: Tessa Morgan <tessa@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-12-01T10:25:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Request: temporary SLA waiver for weekend maintenance

On Mon, Nov 30, 2026 at 09:02 AM Irene Choi <irene@redwood.com> wrote:
> Alex — thanks for the heads up and the form. Important ask; happy to help coordinate.

Summary from infra/CS side: we can approve a timeboxed P2 response-window extension (to 8 hours overnight APAC) for a maximum of 72 hours total (maintenance window + buffer) under two conditions:

- Redwood retains P1 commitments unchanged (immediate acknowledgement + 1 hour response target)
- FinTrade provides a named escalation roster (3 specific contacts) who can call the PA line; ops@fintrade.com can't be an open delegation without names for liability/audit reasons

Operational notes:
- I'll draft the handoff playbook with explicit steps for SUP-2134 creation, required tags, and an included checklist (metrics to observe: 95th latency, 99th, error-rate, and token-error classes).
- Marissa, can you confirm whether Legal needs additional contract wording for a temporary SLA carveout? If so I'll loop them.

Alex — please send the final maintenance window times and a short roster (name/phone/email) for the three folks Redwood should accept escalations from. Once we have that, we'll share the playbook and a DocuSign link.

Thanks,
Ben
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Irene Choi <irene@redwood.com>, Alex Barnes <alex@fintrade.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-12-02T14:08:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Request: temporary SLA waiver for weekend maintenance

Thanks — Ben, that plan sounds reasonable to me from a coverage perspective. A few operational clarifications and runbook decisions:

- Roster: we require (1) primary on-call notifier, (2) backup contact, (3) on-call manager. All three must be named for us to accept delegation.
- Monitoring thresholds: we'll use Redwood's model latency heatmap + FinTrade's supplied dashboards. I'll include exact alert thresholds in the playbook.
- Escalation tree: FinTrade -> Redwood PA (phone/text) -> Backend on-call -> SE on-call -> Eng manager -> SRE director. If no ack at any step within agreed time, automatic re-route to next step.

Operational acceptance: I approve the timeboxed exception (P2 -> 8h overnight APAC) for the dates 2026-12-04T22:00:00+10:00 to 2026-12-07T06:00:00+10:00 (includes 24h buffer after maintenance). We'll publish the playbook and the SUP-2134 template tomorrow morning.

I'll attach the proposed_oncall_handoff_playbook.md and support_escalation_tree.png for signoff.

—Tessa
From: Irene Choi <irene@redwood.com>
To: Alex Barnes <alex@fintrade.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-12-03T16:42:00-08:00
Subject: Final: SLA exception approved (action items and signature)

Alex — final confirmation: Redwood approves the timeboxed SLA exception per Tessa's note. Next steps (actionable):

1) Alex/FinTrade: provide a named roster (3 people) and the definitive maintenance window times by EOD 2026-12-04.
2) FinTrade: fill and return fintrade_exception_form.pdf (attached) and initial SUP-2134 created with tags "maintenance-exception" — we will not accept phone escalations without the ticket link.
3) Redwood: we'll send the DocuSign with the short carveout addendum and the handoff playbook for signatures once we receive the roster and SUP-2134.
4) All: scheduled readiness call Friday 2026-12-04 09:00 PT to walk through the playbook and the monitoring dashboard. Invite link: https://meet.redwood.com/fintrade-sla-call

I've attached the signed playbook draft (proposed_oncall_handoff_playbook.md) and the escalation diagram (support_escalation_tree.png). Ben/Marissa — please confirm regressive-risk review complete; Marissa if Legal needs extra language, flag it now so we can delay DocuSign only if required.

Thanks,
Irene Choi
Head of Customer Success — Redwood Inference
